383:t_1:86.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I... have to get dinner ready... See you later.」

383:t_1:89.en:
$n
「$$カミーユ$$... And you're here too, $$シン$$.」

383:t_1:90.en:
$$シン$$
「Just so you know, we weren't listening to your conversation with $$ティティ$$.」

383:t_1:93.en:
$n
「...Little by little, I feel like I'm finding a way to become one with $$ジェミニオン$$.」

383:t_1:94.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you've learned to spread your awareness outward through your machine.」

383:t_1:95.en:
$n
「Is that what it feels like when you're piloting the $$ゼータ$$?」

383:t_1:96.en:
$$シン$$
「I kind of understand too. My mind clears, and I feel like the $$デスティニー$$ has become part of my body.」

383:t_1:97.en:
$n
「It seems I've gotten a little closer to where you two are.」

383:t_1:98.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm not letting you catch up to me in simulator battles anytime soon.」

383:t_1:99.en:
$n
「Don't think I'll settle for that forever.」

383:t_1:100.en:
$$シン$$
「Then later, I'll show you just how strong I am until you're sick of it.」

383:t_1:101.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It seems you're feeling better.」

383:t_1:102.en:
$n
「I don't have time to keep looking down.」

383:t_1:103.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Then let me talk to you. It's about Miss $$スズネ$$.」

383:t_1:105.en:
$$シン$$
「Tell us how far you're prepared to go. What if $$バルビエル$$ controls Miss $$スズネ$$'s mind and she attacks us as an enemy?」

383:t_1:107.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$バルビエル$$ is a $$スフィア・リアクター$$. I doubt his mind control will be easy to break.」

383:t_1:108.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What will you do then? Will you shoot Miss $$スズネ$$, or let her shoot you?」

383:t_1:110.en:
$$シン$$
「You don't have to answer right now... But I'm sure the time will come when you're forced to make that choice.」

383:t_1:111.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Make up your mind before then.」

383:t_1:113.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We didn't choose either of those...」

383:t_1:115.en:
$$シン$$
「Find your own answer from there, $n.」

383:t_2:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「This empty space...! Is this what $n's mind is like now...!?」

383:t_2:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's a hell where he can't turn to hope or even be allowed to fall into despair...」

383:t_2:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「This is bad...! Even my senses are being stripped away!」

383:t_2:11.en:
$$マーグ$$
「Yes, $$マーズ$$. I've come to help you.」

383:t_2:13.en:
$$マーグ$$
「It's a world beyond hope and despair... It's his inner infinity... his potential.」

383:t_2:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「How did you get here, Brother?」

383:t_2:16.en:
$$マーグ$$
「The older brother of darkness and the younger brother of light... We were originally one soul, split into two beings...」

383:t_2:17.en:
$$マーグ$$
「That is why our darkness and light are stronger than other people's.」

383:t_2:19.en:
$$マーグ$$
「My soul, which has lost its body, lives on within you...」

383:t_2:20.en:
$$マーグ$$
「And the darkness that grew within me will fuse with the light within you.」

383:t_2:21.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wouldn't that mean they'll destroy each other...?」

383:t_2:22.en:
$$マーグ$$
「No. When two opposing forces collide, something beyond them should be born.」

383:t_2:23.en:
$$マーグ$$
「That is why we were able to come here.」

383:t_2:25.en:
$$マーグ$$
「As you are now, you probably cannot accept it.」

383:t_2:26.en:
$$マーグ$$
「But show him a glimpse of the new power that will be born from it.」

383:t_2:28.en:
$$マーグ$$
「$$マーズ$$! Use my power!」

383:t_2:29.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wake up, $n! Go beyond hope and despair!!」

383:t_3:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I never expected you to overcome the $$スフィア$$'s backlash so quickly.」

383:t_3:6.en:
$n
「I recovered thanks to $$タケル$$. It wasn't my own power.」

383:t_3:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「But you should have found a starting point. You'll be able to do it on your own now.」

383:t_3:8.en:
$n
「Thank you, $$タケル$$... And I want to thank your brother too.」

383:t_3:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「I see... So you felt him too.」

383:t_3:10.en:
$$シン$$
「You also perfected the new movement you'd been practicing with $$ジェミニオン$$.」

383:t_3:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「You'd better thank us for helping with your special training too.」

383:t_3:13.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Cut it out. Just because you're starting to stop being the quiet type doesn't mean I want to see you smiling.」

383:t_3:14.en:
$$甲児$$
「But now you've found a way to fight on your own. Can't you be a little happier about it?」

383:t_3:15.en:
$n
「No... Not yet. I can't let my guard down until I get Miss $$スズネ$$ back... and until we take back the Earth.」

383:t_3:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「But once we get Miss $$スズネ$$ back, another problem will come up.」

383:t_3:20.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I've decided! I'm going to challenge Miss $$スズネ$$!」

383:t_3:22.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So make sure you rescue Miss $$スズネ$$. I don't want to lose without a fight.」

383:t_3:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「But judging from $$ギルター$$ today, $$バルビエル$$ will probably use tactics we can't even imagine.」

383:t_3:26.en:
$n
「It's all right, $$カレン$$. $$宗介$$ is keeping me from getting carried away.」

383:t_3:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you plan to do, $n?」
